title: The Definitive Book of Hyperbaric Chamber Therapy: A 24-Chapter Quantitative Biophysical, Molecular, ASME PVHO-1 / NFPA 99 Engineering, and Evidence-Stratified Clinical Monograph
description: Complete 24-chapter, 80-page reference monograph, EPUB 3.0 e-book, 6-page clinical console wall-charts atlas, and 50-question ABMS Undersea & Hyperbaric Medicine board-review workbook synthesizing gas physics (Dalton, Henry, Boyle, Fick, Krogh cylinder), the Hyperoxic-Hypoxic Paradox (HIF-1alpha, SIRT1, PGC-1alpha, 8-fold CD34+ stem cell mobilization), ASME PVHO-1 / NFPA 99 Chapter 14 engineering, all 16 UHMS 15th Edition indications, 43 Europe PMC peer-reviewed papers, and 26 ClinicalTrials.gov trials.
